requirements.text: The personalised timetable management feature should allow students to colour-code their modules.
The personalised timetable management feature should allow students to hide cancelled classes.
The personalised timetable management feature should allow students to add custom study blocks.
The automated grade and deadline notifications should include alerts for newly posted grades.
The automated grade and deadline notifications should include reminders for upcoming assignment deadlines.
The automated grade and deadline notifications should include notifications for exam dates.
The structured module feedback system should enable students to provide feedback on content quality.
The structured module feedback system should enable students to provide feedback on delivery.
The structured module feedback system should enable students to provide feedback on resources.
The structured module feedback system should ensure anonymity for students providing feedback.
All enhancements must integrate with the current authentication system to avoid complicating the login process.
The existing database schema should remain unchanged to preserve system stability.
